findings.one_line: The Fieller coverage proof uses positive variance only at u=mu_t^star; requiring it for every real u is materially stronger and excludes otherwise valid laws without being consumed.

The attested quotation gives only an unspecified mild-regularity normal limit and consistent variance; it does not establish the lemma's claimed joint cell influence representation, exact primitive hypotheses, Fieller studentization, or seven-dimensional Wald conclusion.

cited_checks.note: The supplied verbatim source statement asserts a normal limit and consistent variance only under unspecified 'mild regularity conditions'. It does not, on the supplied record, match the claimed joint cell-level AL representation, the stated iid/positive-arm/finite-second-moment sufficiency, Fieller studentization, or multivariate Wald conclusion.
